senses.zh_definition: 姓氏 Neiman，也见于专名 Neiman Marcus；没有足够依据将小写 neiman 确认为具有普通词义的标准马来语词。
senses.en_definition: A surname, also occurring in the proper name Neiman Marcus; no standard Malay common-word meaning has been established for the supplied token.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang juga terdapat dalam nama khas Neiman Marcus; makna bentuk input ini sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此处 pos=noun 表示专名用途。姓氏和品牌中的 Neiman 通常以大写字母开头；输入包未提供原句，因此不能断定其所指就是该品牌。以下搭配为说明性例组，未验证频率。姓氏及品牌名称的关联见[Neiman Marcus 官方历史](https://www.neimanmarcus.com/editorial/landing-page/in-pursuit-of-the-extraordinary-since-1907)。

etymology.historical_story: Neiman is preserved in the business name Neiman Marcus. The company's history identifies its founders as Herbert Marcus, Carrie Marcus Neiman, and A. L. Neiman, who established the business in Dallas in 1907. This documents a surname becoming part of a commercial name; it does not establish the surname's deeper linguistic origin or a Malay meaning. [Official company history](https://www.neimanmarcus.com/editorial/landing-page/in-pursuit-of-the-extraordinary-since-1907).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Neiman，先联想“姓名中的姓氏”；与 Marcus 连写时辨认完整品牌名，不给它强配马来语普通词义。
